captions.target-1: Instrumental background music for a quick, comic escape: suspenseful anticipation, a sudden heavy impact and nimble, playful motion, leaving space for narration.
captions.target-2: A lively instrumental underscore for a mischievous escape sequence, with rhythmic movement, tension and humorous surprise. No speech or vocals.
captions.check-1: Music for a sly fugitive springing a trap and escaping, balancing danger with deadpan humour and a sense of forward momentum.
captions.check-2: A cinematic accompaniment to sudden slapstick action: a surprising crash, a resourceful criminal and an indignant pursuer. Instrumental music behind a narrator.
captions.contrast: Quiet, unhurried instrumental background music for a reflective landscape passage, with stillness and a spacious, contemplative mood.
captions.unsuitable: Loud heavy metal music with screamed vocals and distorted guitars.

objective: Mean cosine over target-1/target-2 and both fixed ten-second windows, among native-gate-eligible candidates only. Retain all ancestors; deterministic ID breaks exact ties.
limitations: Developer-authored descriptions are not independently validated narrative-fit labels.
One scene, correlated windows and a fresh seed do not establish generalisation to other passages or books.
Held-out wording and seed are checked only after the bounded search; failures do not trigger extra tuning.
Higher CLAP cosine is not established musical quality, reading comfort or personal preference.
No runtime profile or default changes automatically.
